ModMetaData.name: DMS Arc Spray Fire Mode
ModMetaData.author: WhiteGiverMa
ModMetaData.description:
玩家持枪单位与炮塔可随时切换「环世界原版直射 / DMS 原版扫射」。仅玩家阵营可切换，敌人永远保留 DMS 扫射。支持武器基站/支架，随枪械存档。CE 启用时不生效。
Player-only gizmo for vanilla direct fire / original DMS zigzag spray. Supports equipped FFF arc-spray weapons, turrets and weapon stations/mounts. Enemies always spray. Choices follow each gun and persist in saves. No-op with Combat Extended.
